name: Oily Pelts
text: Mire Hounds' pelts are slick with mire-oil. Set one alight and it panics — strike it then (+60% damage to burning hounds).

name: Ink Burns Clean
text: Living ink is oil that remembers. Fire makes it forget — and burning ink near you condenses into Ember.

name: The Hollow Rhythm
text: Thralls strike on the beat of a bell no one else hears. Dodge through the beat and they're open: a perfect dodge primes a guaranteed critical.

name: Counting the Uncounted
text: Under the Edict of Return, echoes rise only when no one is near to remember them. Stand close and they wait; harvest them there without Fray.

name: Hard Water
text: Rime makes water hold — deep water too, for a little while. A frozen pool is a bridge.

name: Kettle's Breath
text: Nothing sees through steam. Fire on water makes cover.

name: Scavengers
text: Hounds eat echoes. Leave a kill unharvested and the pack will come for it — and grow stronger.

name: Ash Remembers
text: Every page you read is a law someone wrote. Somebody wrote you, too.
